findings.body: The browser test creates a session through `test-auth/sign-in` and then navigates to `/onboarding` itself. It never follows the Google sign-in link or checks that the app sends a signed-in person with an incomplete account to onboarding. The test could pass while the real sign-in return flow leaves that person on the invite page, unable to join.
findings.title: Not done: invite sign-in and onboarding return test

findings.body: The helper maps a 429 `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` response to a message telling the person to check their connection and retry. The added test explicitly fixes that behavior, while the browser test setup notes that the API has a real admission rate limit. A rate-limited join needs a plain instruction to wait before trying again; the current message gives the wrong cause and recovery step.
findings.title: Explain rate-limit refusals accurately

findings.body: This new file contains only branch status and a start timestamp. It is outside both paths allowed for this part and is not needed by the invite page or its tests.
findings.title: Remove the task status file outside the allowed paths
